message: I recently found myself in the midst of a surprise blackout while I was getting dinner ready. Thankfully, I had brushed up on some helpful tips about handling power outages. It felt like a small win when I remembered to gather my flashlights, keep the fridge closed, and set up some cozy candles. It turned a potentially stressful situation into a unique family adventure! 🌟 What’s your go-to tip for weathering a blackout?
